name: level-ring
title: Level ring
description: The same progress, drawn round: an SVG ring for a level, an XP bar or anything with something to show in the middle. A separate component rather than a variant of `progress-bar` because a ring and a bar share no layout code, and identical in meaning because they share the contract: `data-gs-value` over `data-gs-max`, the same four states, and the same `--gs-progress` custom property carrying the fraction. `pathLength="1"` makes the dash array a fraction of the way round, so the stylesheet never needs the circumference, and the stroke reads a colour token like every other colour. The stroke travels over the fill motion token and stops dead under reduced motion, so completion also changes the stroke's colour and adds a glyph, which are emphasis and survive. Performs nothing: it does not award XP or advance the level, and reaching `max` does not mark it complete; the host supplies the value and declares completion. Use `progress-bar` when the player needs a horizontal track showing how far through the round they are, with no content in the middle.
docs: Takes the same props as `progress-bar`: `value` with `max`, `indeterminate` when there is no fraction, `min` for a floor that is not zero, `complete` when the host says so, and `format` for the announced figure. Children go in the middle and are never announced, because the ring's own accessible name already carries the number, so a level number, an icon or a `Stat` can sit there without being read twice. Size the ring by setting width and height on the root; the stroke does not scale with it, by design.
